description.narrative: Loan proceeds will be earmarked for SME financing in Indonesia. VIHC will deploy the funds through the Group’s local platform operated by PT Berdayakan Usaha Indonesia (aka “Batumbu”). The Batumbu platform is fully licensed by the Indonesian Financial Services Authority (“OJK”) and extends productive loans to credit-constrained and underserved SMEs by following an upstream and downstream supply chain approach, thereby creating sustainable ecosystems and driving SME growth through financial inclusion. A considerable part of its loan book is targeted at rural and youth-owned (entrepreneurs under the age of 35) SMEs.
